context.body: The bounded canonical source is Judges 19:22–30; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Men surround the house, a woman is handed over, abused, and dies, and her body is divided and sent through Israel.
observations.label: An atrocity is sent throughout Israel: action

observations.body: recipients say such a thing has not happened since Egypt.
observations.label: An atrocity is sent throughout Israel: response

payload.posture: Read Judges 19:22–30 as tribes in the land evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The woman’s voice is absent, and the shocking appeal to collective memory comes through further violation of her body.
payload.title: An atrocity is sent throughout Israel
